## Qualified and published — 2026-10-08

31 host controls pass against four original-source failures. Both actual target screenshot actions use the expected default/custom destination and preserve history. The generated native PNG survives ordinary installed saves-only backup/restore exactly; complete provider manifests prove 38 earlier files unchanged. This uses an original synthetic reset ROM, not commercial gameplay qualification.

Product integration `e6645cb5ea5ae3c7f699390a74b22d098fbeb7fb` and [retained proof](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/bc4ae05d30531516ebd19b6b167fc994f368c4c3/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-08-save-repair-cases) are published on next `bc4ae05d30531516ebd19b6b167fc994f368c4c3`; ES integration is `4e410dc9a816cc947f16235ad2b24824b29dd84e`. The independent delta audit (#507), assembled firmware inclusion/public adoption (#508), affected device builds and release gates remain separate. #519 must pass before the owner's next handheld update transfer/reboot. No personal cloud or physical action was part of this qualification.

The sections below retain the problem, requirement and investigation history; this status supersedes their earlier in-progress observations.

## Problem and placement

Found during #515's finite source review. The configured DuckStation screenshot action writes ordinary player captures outside the local saves/screenshot tree. This is a separate confirmed coverage defect from child #520's cloud-filter fixes; qualify it before #508 integration and #507's frozen audit.

## Code trace

- Trigger: the shipped screenshot hotkey calls exact packaged DuckStation v0.1-10998 `src/core/hotkeys.cpp:127–131`, then `System::SaveScreenshot()` with no explicit path (`system.h:421–424`).
- Writer: `system.cpp:5629–5661` selects `EmuFolders::Screenshots`; `settings.cpp:2709–2717,2733` resolves the folder relative to DataRoot. The launcher maps default data to `/storage/.config/duckstation`; its only progress-directory links are states and cards.
- Seeds: AMD64 explicitly uses `Folders/Screenshots=screenshots`; H700 and InputPlumber omit an override and use the same upstream default. GENERIC_X64 selects InputPlumber. All have the screenshot action. Default captures land outside `SAVESPATH=/storage/roms`, so the ordinary screenshots allowlist cannot include them.
- Required behavior: new default player screenshots use the existing backed-up screenshots tree, preserving explicit custom paths and all pre-existing captures. Handle existing default configurations as well as clean seeds. Do not add a general file-reorganization or cloud-migration feature.
- Already written: older default captures may remain in the application-data screenshot directory and may be absent from save backups. Keep these originals intact; qualify an explicit treatment of that history and document any manual action, rather than silently deleting, replacing or claiming them backed up. Existing states/cards and custom screenshot choices must remain unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Exact pinned action/writer/config/launcher evidence identifies the default path on GENERIC_X64 and H700; a synthetic old-launcher control demonstrates exclusion from the normal screenshot/save scope.
- [x] A bounded, reviewed implementation directs new default screenshots into the covered tree on clean and retained default configurations, preserves explicit custom paths and all existing screenshot bytes, and remains safe on repeated launch, conflicting/unwritable paths and failure.
- [x] Source-derived fixtures prove actual launcher/config behavior and old-capture retention, rather than only testing a mirrored helper; backup/restore coverage is shown with real rclone.
- [x] Applicable target-runtime screenshot/flow proof and canonical reference/changelog disposition accompany the source, with exact inputs and limits. No whole-library operation or private-device/cloud action is needed.
- [x] #515 case disposition and #508/#507 final scope include the qualified change and explicitly remaining firmware inclusion gates.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes. Use synthetic disposable launcher/config/filesystem fixtures and GENERIC_X64 for target-runtime proof. No personal captures, device actions or cloud credentials are required. Keep compact receipts and retire scratch when its named proof completes.


## DuckStation runtime prerequisite — #522

Actual GENERIC_X64 proof for #521 found the exact pinned AppImage installed mode0644; direct execution refuses with126. #522 fixes explicit package executable mode and proves original/fixed install behavior plus real target entrypoint execution. It precedes #521 screenshot runtime acceptance. Preserve the source/cache bytes and persistent saves; no guest-only chmod is a product fix. Include this input in #508 integration and #507 scope.


## Qualification update — 2026-10-08

#520 source coverage is qualified locally at `1ee8e5199da0bc02e6aa4ebff94b951f5e8b4804`: 39 focused controls, 21 content regressions, 30 validator regressions and nine actual-image BusyBox controls pass. The affected VM UI packet has ten reviewed frames, one retained rejected fixture frame and no pending #520 UI case; root verified all 194 sealed files and unchanged content/configuration witnesses. Publication/inclusion still belongs to #508.

#521/#522 local commit `dda2a04aaf411b8bc13aedf5ce44ff33ce4b3d3a` passes 31 host controls against four original-source failures. Actual guest proof confirms executable permission repair, preserved custom/history state and the helper behavior. The real application loader then exposed #523: missing `libcom_err.so.2`. A complete 121-ELF/plugin scan found this sole unresolved SONAME. Qualify the target-built dependency and actual rendered capture before claiming #521 runtime completion. No host-library substitution, personal cloud or physical action is involved.

Current order: finish #523 and #521 runtime proof, reconcile #515's finite instructions-only relocation disposition, integrate #508, freeze/audit #507, then assembled GENERIC_X64 clean/public adoption and affected H700 followed by SM8550 builds. No external audit or new firmware build has started. #519 separately gates the owner's next handheld update transfer/reboot; old consumers and active fallback configs require controlled alignment and residue disposition first.
